verdict.rationale: AI-native users can run Brave Search through natural-language prompts using the official, first-party Brave Search MCP server, which exposes web, local, image, video and news search, LLM context and summarization to clients like Claude desktop. Official Skills cover Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex and others, and the Answers endpoint takes natural-language questions and returns grounded answers, including iterative deep research. Missing for 10: no natural-language control of account, key or plan management (only search operations are exposed), the NL experience depends on a third-party AI client, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of NL operation quality.
